battle.name: 蕭繹討平侯景之亂
battle.theater: 建康石頭城與沿江防線
battle.brief: 蕭繹以湘東王鎮荊州，建康陷落後他不爭一城一池，先造船儲糧，坐等侯景與朝廷互耗；承聖元年遣王僧辯率大軍順流東下、陳霸先率西軍溯流北上，會師石頭城，侯景兵潰被平。卡面斯巴達長矛並未隨軍而至，其代表密集方陣的挺刺邏輯；梁軍所恃是弩陣、舟師與糧道，勝在縱深補給，非正面硬撞。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 侯景之亂是梁朝末年規模最大的一場內戰，交戰雙方在同一條江防線上改變了彼此的位置。正方是盤據建康的梁王朝，聽命於梁武帝蕭衍的中央朝廷，骨幹是揚州、荊州、益州、寧州的州郡兵，由諸王與重臣分任大都督、刺史，各領本部；蕭衍晚年怠於政事，宮中與禁軍要職多歸外家與佞倖，正軍之令反而出於諸王之手，調度極不統一。叛方是侯景率領的北方邊軍集團：侯景本為懷州出身的邊將，先隸爾朱榮，後歸高歡，官至東魏河南尹，又在梁大同年間叛魏降梁，受封司空，掌淮南兵權；起兵時他以清君側為名，麾下多河北降人與胡騎騎兵，語言、編制與江南州郡兵全然不同，入建康後另立傀儡皇帝，盡據宮府與府庫，並自建元稱帝。蕭繹一方則是建康淪陷後在長江中游另立的軍政集團，以湘東王蕭繹為最高統帥，王僧辯總攝大軍順流東下，陳霸先率西軍溯流而北，合肥守軍韋叡與江州、寧州的地方武裝各自成軍，彼此編制不屬而靠檄令與糧餉維繫。整個戰局裡並存兩套軍令系統：梁廷的號令隨建康陷落而失效，荊州一系的號令只覆蓋長江中游；而蕭繹與王僧辯、陳霸先之間互相防範，這層緊張在戰後立刻變成殺王僧辯、架空陳霸先的權力鬥爭。
countriesEn: The rebellion of Hou Jing was the largest civil war of the late Liang, and the two sides changed each other's position on the same river front. On one side stood the Liang court seated at Jiankang, answering to Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan; its backbone was the departmental and commandery troops of Yangzhou, Jingzhou, Yizhou and Ningzhou, commanded by princes and great ministers who each held their own appointment as Great Commander or Cishi and led their own men. Xiao Yan had grown negligent in his last years, the key posts in the palace and the palace guards had gone to his in-laws and to flatterers, and the effective orders of the field army came instead from the princes, so that coordination was extremely poor. On the other side stood the northern frontier military group of Hou Jing. Hou Jing was by origin a frontier commander from Huai prefecture; he had served under Erzhu Rong and then gone over to Gao Huan, rising to be Henan Yin of Eastern Wei, and in the Datong reign of Liang he rebelled from Wei and surrendered to Liang, receiving the office of Sikong and command of the troops south of the Huai. When he rose he took the words clearing the ruler's side as his pretext; his following was made up largely of men surrendered from the north and of Hu cavalry, whose language and organisation were wholly unlike the departmental troops of the south. Once in Jiankang he set up a puppet emperor, took the palace treasury, and proclaimed his own reign. The side of Xiao Yi was a separate military-political group created in the middle Yangtze after the fall of the capital, with the Prince of Xiaodong, Xiao Yi, as its supreme commander; Wang Sengbian commanded the main army down the river, Chen Baxian led the western army up it, the garrison of Hefei under Wei Rui and the local levies of Jiangzhou and Ningzhou each formed bodies of their own, and none of them belonged to the same organisation, being held together only by written orders and by the shipment of grain and pay. Two systems of command existed side by side through the whole war: the orders of the Liang court had been voided by the fall of Jiankang, and the orders of the Jingzhou group covered only the middle reaches of the river. Between Xiao Yi and Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian there was mutual watchfulness, and that tension turned immediately after the war into the murder of Wang Sengbian and the setting aside of Chen Baxian.
people: 蕭繹是全場最耐心的那一位。他是梁武帝蕭衍的皇子，母氏阮氏，成年後封湘東王，太平二年間出鎮荊州，任寧遠將軍、荊州刺史，兼錄尚書事，把江陵經營成梁室在長江中游唯一穩固的根據地。侯景陷建康時他按兵不動，先徵兵、造船、籌糧，等侯景與朝廷互相消耗，才於大寶元年冬以王僧辯為大都督遣師東下，自己坐鎮江陵主持糧運與節制；承聖元年三月大軍進抵石頭城，侯景兵敗被平，十一月蕭繹在江陵即位為梁元帝。統兵者方面：王僧辯是琅琊臨沂人，早年在大將軍司州刺史帳下任職，侯景起兵時率部曲隨蕭淵明討侯景而兵降敵，事後逃還，受蕭繹信用，統主力順流東下，是名帥而與蕭繹有隙。陳霸先出身寒微，吳興長城人，起義時在廣陵一帶收聚甲士，侯景遣宋子仙等攻廣陵，他擊退之；承聖元年率西軍溯流北上，以數百人為前驅夜渡江，會師後直取采石，破了侯景的舟師，是全役最關鍵的一擊。侯景字萬景，懷州人，久與北朝周旋，叛梁前是梁的河南尹、司空，與宗室及朝廷積怨，其人驍勇善騎射而刻忌寡恩，部將多死於猜疑。侯景身邊最能言者是參軍王偉，攻城前後出檄文、遊說建康守將，侯景平後為追兵所殺。建康守將羊侃拒降，以朱雀航的拍駕拋石擊碎侯景木驢，城破後不屈而死。梁宗室蕭淵明領兵討侯景，部將杜僧明暗通敵人，全軍為侯景所併，成為梁軍最初的崩解點。陳霸先帳下侯安都以夜襲采石舟師而得名，此役之後躍為名將。
peopleEn: Xiao Yi was the most patient of the principals. He was a son of Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan, his mother was of the Ruan clan, and after coming of age he was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiaodong; in the second year of the Taiping era he was sent out to govern Jingzhou as Ningyuan Jiangjun and Cishi of Jingzhou, concurrently taking charge of the affairs of the secretariat, and he turned Jiangling into the only solid base the Liang house still possessed in the middle Yangtze. When Hou Jing took Jiankang he did not move; he levied men, built boats and stored grain, and waited for Hou Jing and the court to wear each other down, only in the eleventh month of the first year of the Chengsheng era, in the winter of the Dabao year, sending the army east with Wang Sengbian as great commander while he himself sat at Jiangling directing the grain and the command; in the third month of the Chengsheng era the army reached the Stone City and Hou Jing was defeated, and in the eleventh month of the same year Xiao Yi took the throne at Jiangling as Emperor Yuan of Liang. Among the field commanders, Wang Sengbian was a native of LinYi in Langya and had served early in life under the command of the General-in-Chief and Cishi of Sizhou; when Hou Jing rose he led his men with Xiao Yuanming against Hou Jing and his troops went over to the enemy, and after escaping back he was trusted by Xiao Yi and given the main army to command down the river, and though a fine general he was at odds with Xiao Yi. Chen Baxian was a man of humble origin, a native of Changcheng in Wuxing; when the rising began he was gathering armoured men around Guangling and beat back the force Hou Jing sent under Song Zixian and others to attack Guangling. In the first year of Chengsheng he led the western army up the river, took several hundred men as his vanguard and crossed the river by night, and after joining forces struck at Caishi and broke Hou Jing's flotilla, which was the decisive blow of the whole campaign. Hou Jing, whose courtesy name was Wanjing, was a native of Huai prefecture, long at odds with the northern courts, and before he rebelled he had been Henan Yin and Sikong of Liang; he had quarrelled with the imperial clan and with the court, and though brave and skilled with the bow and the horse he was suspicious and mean, and many of his officers were killed on suspicion. The most talkative man around Hou Jing was his staff officer Wang Wei, who issued the proclamations before and during the siege and worked on the defenders of Jiankang; after Hou Jing was put down Wang Wei was killed by the pursuing troops. The defender of Jiankang, Yang Kan, refused to surrender and broke Hou Jing's wooden rams with the stone-throwing engines of the Zhunque wharf, and he died unbroken after the city fell. The Liang prince Xiao Yuanming took the field against Hou Jing, but one of his officers, Du Ming, was in secret correspondence with the enemy, and the whole army was swallowed by Hou Jing, which was the first point at which the Liang army broke. Under Chen Baxian, Hou Andu made his name by the night attack on the flotilla at Caishi, and after this campaign he rose to be counted among the leading generals.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛(dory)並沒有出現在侯景或蕭繹的任何一方，它是希臘世界的武器，約自公元前八百年起流行於斯巴達與希臘城邦：兩米上下的木槍，槍頭為鐵製矛刃，槍尾包銅套，重心偏前，握在手中像一根放長了的矛。斯巴達長矛的意義不在長短，而在使用方式——密集方陣之中，槍尖一律朝前，戰士彼此掩護，靠整列同時挺刺的衝力把對手推倒，這與靠個人格殺的劍完全不同，所以它被說成比劍更早決定誰站得住。梁軍的近戰主力則是槍與矛：槍是直木桿加鐵矛頭，長度多在一丈上下，格鬥仍以挺刺為主，輔以揮擊；兩者的邏輯與斯巴達長矛同源，都是把刺擊壓在盾陣與隊形的前沿。但梁軍沒有斯巴達那樣的公民方陣制度，兵源是各州郡的鄉兵與降人，編制鬆散，陣形一破便難以重整，所以蕭繹的取勝之道不在正面硬撞，而在水陸協同與斷敵退路。梁軍裝備的其餘部分：遠射以弓、弩為主，弩機以木為骨、銅為機，射程覆蓋城牆與江面；防護是皮甲、札甲與漆皮大盾，將領與近衛另佩環首刀與劍；攻城與守城的器械更決定成敗：侯景造木驢，以牛皮蒙覆、載兵附城，又用飛梯與土山逼近，羊侃以拍駕擊碎其木驢；蕭繹方面依靠水軍戰船、炬火與夜襲，侯安都即以火船焚侯景在采石的舟師。運輸靠沿江的糧船，蕭繹自荊州運糧而下，陳霸先又自京口密運米食接濟王僧辯，全役的真正勝負手是糧道。
kitsEn: The Spartan dory on the card was present on neither side of this war, in Hou Jing's army or in Xiao Yi's. It is a weapon of the Greek world, in use among the Spartans and the Greek poleis from about 800 BC: a wooden shaft of some two metres with an iron blade at the head and a bronze cap at the butt, its balance forward, held in the hand like a lengthened spear. The significance of the dory lay not in its length but in the manner of its use. In a dense phalanx all the points faced forward, the men covered one another, and the impact of a whole rank thrusting simultaneously pushed the enemy over; this was entirely different from the sword, which fought man against man, which is why the dory is said to have decided who would stand before the sword did. The close-combat main force of the Liang army was the qiang and the mao: the qiang was a straight wooden shaft with an iron spearhead, commonly a little over three metres, fought mainly by thrusting and secondarily by sweeping; the logic of both is the same as that of the Spartan dory, for both press the thrust onto the front edge of the shield wall and of the formation. But the Liang had no Spartan citizen phalanx system. Their men were departmental levies and surrendered men from the various provinces, loosely organised, and once a formation broke it could not be reformed, so Xiao Yi's road to victory lay not in frontal collision but in the coordination of water and land and in cutting the enemy's line of retreat. The rest of the Liang equipment: missiles were shot with bows and crossbows, the crossbow lock made of wood and bronze, with a range that covered the city wall and the river surface; protection was leather armour, lamellar armour and large lacquered shields, while officers and the close guard carried ring-pommelled sabres and swords. The siege and defence engines mattered even more: Hou Jing built wooden rams covered with hide to carry men up to the wall, and used scaling ladders and earthen ramps to close in, and Yang Kan shattered those rams with his stone-throwing engines; on Xiao Yi's side the campaign rested on war boats, torches and night attacks, and it was Hou Andu who fired the flaming boats against Hou Jing's flotilla at Caishi. Transport ran on the grain boats of the river: Xiao Yi sent grain down from Jingzhou, and Chen Baxian privately carried rice from Jingkou to keep Wang Sengbian's army fed. The real decisive instrument of the whole war was the supply line.
tactics: 侯景的戰法是典型的攻城消耗：起兵之後不急於攻堅，而是先取壽陽、濠州一帶為基地，再據采石、姑孰渡江，沿秦淮水、潮溝至石頭城築營列柵，把營寨與水道連成一片，供給靠船，攻城靠器械。蕭衍屢次派兵討伐，蕭淵明所部又因部將私通而全軍為侯景所併，侯景自此居高臨下。建康之圍自太清三年初開始，歷百餘日：侯景造木驢、飛梯攻朱雀航，羊侃以拍駕拋石擊其所中皆碎，侯景改築土山逼近，攻城同時切斷城內糧道，城中軍需漸乏。蕭繹的戰法是相反的兩手：其一是以江陵為根本，不在下游與侯景爭一城一池，而是徵兵、造船、儲糧，等候對手與朝廷殘餘互相消耗；其二是在關鍵時刻集中兵力。承聖元年正月侯景請降並索要江右之地，蕭繹集群臣議，王僧辯主張割地，陳霸先力爭，蕭繹乃罷割地之議而受其降，侯景見欺而怒，聯軍得以名正言順進兵。三月，王僧辯率大軍順流而東，陳霸先率西軍溯流而上，兩軍會於石頭城下：霸先遣侯安都率水軍夜襲采石舟師，斷侯景水退之路；大軍進逼，侯景眾潰，退保覆舟山，隨從不過數百，追兵合圍，侯景死於亂軍，屍為士卒所爭食。聯軍內部並不融洽：蕭繹遠供糧草而有意留一線，陳霸先密運米食以濟王僧辯，兩人一面共謀，一面互相防備。侯景平後，王僧辯入軍中樞，蕭繹以久屯京口、威權過盛為由召回荊州，於承聖三年將其殺害。
tacticsEn: Hou Jing's method was the classic attrition of a siege. After raising his forces he did not hurry to assault; he first took the country of Shouyang and Hao as his base, then crossed the river at Caishi and Gudou, and ran out a line of camps and palisades from the Qinhuai and the Chaogou as far as the Stone City, joining his works to the waterways so that supply came by boat and siege by engine. The Liang sent force after force, and the troops of Xiao Yuanming were swallowed whole because one of their officers was in secret communication with Hou Jing, after which Hou Jing held the high ground. The investment of Jiankang began in the first months of the third year of the Taiping era and ran for more than a hundred days. Hou Jing built wooden rams and scaling ladders against the Zhunque wharf and Yang Kan shattered them with his stone-throwing engines, so that Hou Jing fell back on earthen ramps; the siege and the cutting of the grain route within the city ran together, and the defenders grew short of supplies. Xiao Yi's method was the mirror image of this, in two hands. First, he took Jiangling as his root and did not contest a single town or pool with Hou Jing downstream; he levied men, built boats and stored grain, and waited for the enemy and the remnant of the court to consume one another. Second, he concentrated his strength at the critical moment. In the first month of the first year of Chengsheng Hou Jing asked to surrender and demanded the lands east of the river; Xiao Yi called his ministers together, Wang Sengbian argued for ceding the land and Chen Baxian argued hard against it, and Xiao Yi thereupon set aside the cession while accepting the surrender, at which Hou Jing, feeling deceived, was angry, and the allied army could advance in good conscience. In the third month Wang Sengbian led the great army down the river and Chen Baxian led the western army up it, and the two met below the Stone City. Baxian sent Hou Andu with the flotilla to attack Hou Jing's boats at Caishi by night, cutting the water route by which Hou Jing might have withdrawn; the main army closed in, Hou Jing's host broke, and he fell back to the Fuzhou hill with no more than a few hundred men about him. The pursuing troops closed the ring and Hou Jing was killed in the rout, and his body was torn to pieces by his own soldiers. The alliance was not harmonious within itself: Xiao Yi sent grain from far off and deliberately held something back, Chen Baxian privately carried rice to keep Wang Sengbian fed, and the two men plotted together while watching each other. After Hou Jing was put down Wang Sengbian took the centre of the army, and Xiao Yi, citing the long stay at Jingkou and the excess of his authority, summoned him to Jingzhou and had him killed in the third year of Chengsheng.
data: 可核對的數字集中在時間線與幾個大數上。時間軸最清楚：太清二年十月侯景起兵，太清三年春建康陷落，同年四月梁武帝崩，侯景自大寶元年建元稱帝，承聖元年三月大軍進抵石頭城、四月侯景死，蕭繹同年十一月即位改元承聖，首尾約三年半。兵力方面：侯景起兵之初只有數千之眾，收蕭淵明降卒萬餘後兵勢大盛，通鑑記其眾以萬計，至渡江圍城時已是一支自居以十萬眾的大軍；梁軍主力依通鑑所記為王僧辯所將諸軍二十萬，但此數包括沿途徵發與隨軍之眾，實際能戰之卒當遠少於此。陳霸先的西軍人數不見於史，只載其夜渡江時以數百人為前驅，可見精銳之少。器械與行程方面，侯景圍建康歷百餘日，造木驢、飛梯與土山，羊侃以拍駕擊碎其木驢；平亂之後，侯景的妻王氏與幼子被送京口誅，首級與妻子同赴建康。戰後的數字統計則極為簡略：《梁書》與《通鑑》都只說侯景軍中大疫、士卒死亡甚眾，沒有可確證的殲滅數；故其敗亡既因潰散，也因疫病與斷糧，而非一次會戰的殞滅。凡引用「二十萬」「十餘萬」之類數目，皆須按史家通例打折，不可當作交戰雙方的實際在場人數。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked are concentrated on the chronology and on a few large figures. The sequence of time is the clearest thing here: Hou Jing raised his forces in the tenth month of the second year of Taiping; Jiankang fell in the spring of the third year of Taiping; in the fourth month of that same year Emperor Wu of Liang died; Hou Jing proclaimed his own reign from the first year of Dabao; in the third month of the first year of Chengsheng the army reached the Stone City and in the fourth month Hou Jing was dead; Xiao Yi took the throne in the eleventh month of the same year and changed the era to Chengsheng. The whole affair thus ran a little over three and a half years. On numbers of troops: at the outset Hou Jing had only some thousands of men, and after taking the more than ten thousand who came over from Xiao Yuanming his strength grew large, the Tongjian records that he counted his host by tens of thousands, and by the time he had crossed the river and ringed the capital he already commanded what was reckoned as a hundred thousand men. The main Liang force is given in the Tongjian as the twenty thousand and more troops led by Wang Sengbian, but that figure covers men levied along the route and the camp followers, and the number actually able to fight must have been far lower. The size of Chen Baxian's western army does not appear in the histories, which record only that he took a few hundred men as his vanguard when he crossed the river by night, showing how thin the picked troops were. On engines and distances: Hou Jing's investment of Jiankang lasted more than a hundred days and included wooden rams, scaling ladders and earthen ramps, and Yang Kan shattered the rams with his stone-throwers; after the rising was put down Hou Jing's wife, née Wang, and his young son were sent to Jingkou and executed, and the head and the wife were brought to Jiankang. The statistics after the war are extremely thin: both the Liangshu and the Tongjian say only that there was a great epidemic in Hou Jing's army and that a great many soldiers died of it, and there is no verifiable figure for the destruction; his collapse was the work of a rout, of disease and of a cut supply line together, and not the destruction of a single pitched battle. Whenever figures such as two hundred thousand or a hundred thousand odd are quoted, they should be discounted in the usual way that historians do, and must not be treated as the number of men actually present on the field on either side.
cause: 打起來有兩層原因，一層是侯景與梁朝廷之間的死結，一層是梁室諸王彼此的算計。侯景原是北朝邊將，先在爾朱榮麾下，後歸高歡，官至東魏河南尹；他在梁大同年間叛魏降梁，被蕭衍收留並授以河南尹、司空之位，率淮南兵，卻因來路與出身不見容於士族，又屢為朝廷猜忌逼迫，只好再叛以自保。梁武帝晚年的政治已壞：太子蕭統早逝，諸王爭儲，蕭衍不置可否，禁軍與宮中要職多授外家，朝令不出中樞，這正是清君側四字能夠奏效的緣由。侯景起兵於壽陽、濠州一帶，先以詐降與內應瓦解蕭淵明所部，收江淮降兵，渡江之後即成不可制之勢。蕭衍雖屢遣重兵討伐，卻因諸王各領自己的兵而不相統一，援軍常逗留觀望，一誤再誤，遂致建康淪陷。荊州方面蕭繹的算計同樣清楚：他出鎮荊州多年，兵精糧足，是侯景無法染指的西翼；他所要的並非拯救梁室，而是趁亂統一長江中游，把朝廷的軍政資源盡收己手。於是蕭繹不急於出兵，他等的正是侯景與蕭衍互相削弱的那一刻，兵鋒所指也只是侯景的船隊與退路，而梁室宗親的性命，在他算盤上的位置低於荊州的安全。
causeEn: There were two layers of cause, one a deadlock between Hou Jing and the Liang court, the other the calculations of the Liang princes one with another. Hou Jing had been a frontier commander of the northern courts, serving under Erzhu Rong and then going over to Gao Huan and rising to be Henan Yin of Eastern Wei. In the Datong reign of Liang he rebelled from Wei and surrendered to Liang, and Xiao Yan took him in and gave him the offices of Henan Yin and Sikong with command of the troops south of the Huai; but his origin and his manner of arrival were not acceptable to the aristocratic clans, and he was repeatedly goaded and distrusted by the court, until he had to rebel again to save himself. The politics of Liang had gone bad in the last years of Emperor Wu. The crown prince Xiao Tong had died young, the princes fought over the succession, Xiao Yan took no side, the palace guards and the key offices in the palace went to his in-laws, and the orders of the court no longer came from its centre; this was precisely the ground on which the words clearing the ruler's side could take hold. Hou Jing raised his forces in the country of Shouyang and Hao, broke up the army of Xiao Yuanming by means of a feigned surrender and treachery inside it, took over the surrendered men of the river regions, and once across the river became a force that could no longer be held. Xiao Yan sent heavy force after heavy force, but since the princes each led their own men without any unity, the relief armies stood and watched, and error followed upon error until Jiankang fell. The calculation on the Jingzhou side was equally clear. Xiao Yi had governed Jingzhou for years with fine troops and full granaries, and was the western flank that Hou Jing could not touch; what he wanted was not the rescue of the Liang house but the unification of the middle Yangtze while all was confusion, so that the military and fiscal resources of the court would come into his own hands. He was in no hurry to march, for what he was waiting for was the moment when Hou Jing and Xiao Yan had weakened one another; the point of his army was Hou Jing's flotilla and his line of retreat, and the lives of Liang princes sat lower in his reckoning than the security of Jingzhou.
impact: 侯景之亂平定之後，南朝的局面並未恢復，反而加速崩解。第一，梁的國力被徹底耗空：建康在百餘日的圍攻之後殘破不堪，宮府、府庫與江南膏腴之地被侯景反覆搜括，數年的積蓄歸於一空，復元的工程反而成了蕭繹求援與遷都江陵時的沉重負擔。第二，北魏立刻趁虛南下：侯景一死，淮南的真空立刻被填上，魏軍進逼鍾離、合肥一線，梁的江防整條後撤到長江以北，北方對南方的壓力自此再沒有消失。第三，權力集中到荊州一系：蕭繹即位江陵，誅王僧辯，削蕭氏諸王兵權，又以陳霸先為西軍主將、錄尚書事，把軍國大政收到自己與一二人手中，梁末這套高度集權的格局，正是陳霸先三年之內完成代梁的制度前提。第四，軍隊組成也在變：侯景軍中胡騎、械具與江南舟師的結合，說明南北朝的軍事技術在這一役裡互相傳染；而蕭繹軍靠水軍、弩手與糧道作戰，重水戰、尚舟師、講縱深的取向，為南朝末年的防禦定了型。第五，這場戰爭的記錄本身成了政治資源：侯景方面的檄文與江南士人對侯景的痛詆，後來都被用來論證國之不可以無法，侯景由叛臣變成後世論政時的永備喻例，而《資治通鑑》記梁亡，幾乎全歸結於蕭衍之昏與侯景之逆。
impactEn: After the rebellion of Hou Jing had been put down the southern court did not recover; it fell apart faster. First, the strength of Liang was completely spent. Jiankang, after a hundred days and more of investment, was a ruin, and the palace treasury and the fat counties of the south were repeatedly stripped by Hou Jing, so that the accumulations of several years were gone, and the work of restoration became a heavy burden for Xiao Yi when he sued for help and moved the capital to Jiangling. Second, the Northern Wei moved south at once into the vacancy. With Hou Jing dead, the gap in the Huai region was filled, Wei troops pressed towards the line of Zhongli and Hefei, and the river defence of Liang was moved back in its entirety to the north of the Yangtze, after which the northern pressure on the south was never lifted again. Third, power was concentrated in the Jingzhou line. Xiao Yi took the throne at Jiangling, killed Wang Sengbian, took away the troops of the other Liang princes, and made Chen Baxian commander of the western army and recorder of the secretariat, gathering the government of the state into the hands of himself and one or two others; and this highly centralised order of the late Liang was precisely the institutional precondition for Chen Baxian to displace the Liang within three years. Fourth, the composition of the armies changed as well. The combination in Hou Jing's host of Hu cavalry, siege engines and southern river craft shows the military techniques of the north and the south infecting one another in this single war; and the army of Xiao Yi fought with river craft, crossbowmen and supply lines, and this weighting of naval war, of river craft and of depth set the mould of southern defence in the last years of the dynasty. Fifth, the record of the war itself became a political resource. The proclamations issued on the side of Hou Jing and the denunciations of him by the scholars of the south were afterwards used to argue that a state cannot be left without law, and Hou Jing passed from rebel to permanent example in later discussion of government, while the Tongjian in its account of the fall of Liang attributes it almost entirely to the folly of Xiao Yan and the revolt of Hou Jing.
result: 承聖元年三月，王僧辯大軍自上游順流而東，陳霸先的西軍溯流而北，會於石頭城；侯景之眾先潰於采石舟師之焚，繼而退保覆舟山，隨從不過數百人，兵盡之後侯景為追兵所殺，屍為士卒爭食；其妻王氏與幼子被送京口，一併誅之。十一月蕭繹在江陵即位，改元承聖，是為梁元帝。侯景的政權自建康陷落到覆亡，前後不足四年；蕭繹這一邊贏得了戰爭的全部，卻沒有贏得太平：同年他召回王僧辯入荊州，以其威權過盛為由殺之，陳霸先的西軍隨即成為唯一能與之抗衡的力量，江陵朝廷的孤立由此定型。若以戰役本身論成敗，決定勝負的並非任何一次正面交鋒：侯景在江淮的攻勢為自己贏得堡壘與人數，卻把補給線越拉越長；蕭繹放棄爭奪建康、保存荊州軍力，等對手耗盡於疫病與圍城，最後以水陸協同、夜襲斷退路、兩軍夾擊一舉傾覆。斯巴達長矛所代表的那種密集挺刺，靠的是整個方陣與公民體制，梁軍沒有這種東西，卻在長江的水網裡找到了自己的等價物：弩陣在岸上壓住城頭，舟師在江心切斷退路，糧船自上游接續不斷——這才是這場戰爭真正的武器。
resultEn: In the third month of the first year of Chengsheng the great army of Wang Sengbian came down the river from the upper reaches and the western army of Chen Baxian came up from the north, and they met below the Stone City. The host of Hou Jing was first broken by the burning of his boats at Caishi, then fell back to the Fuzhou hill with no more than a few hundred men about him, and when the fighting was done Hou Jing was killed by the pursuing troops, his body torn to pieces by the soldiers themselves; his wife, née Wang, and his young son were sent to Jingkou and executed with him. In the eleventh month of the same year Xiao Yi took the throne at Jiangling and changed the era to Chengsheng, becoming Emperor Yuan of Liang. The regime of Hou Jing, from the fall of Jiankang to its end, lasted less than four years. Xiao Yi's side won the war entire, but it won no peace: in the same year he summoned Wang Sengbian to Jingzhou and had him killed on the ground that his authority had grown excessive, the western army of Chen Baxian at once became the only force able to counter him, and the isolation of the Jiangling court was fixed from that point on. If the campaign is judged as a campaign, no single frontal engagement decided it. The offensive Hou Jing made along the river won him strongholds and numbers, but lengthened his supply line the whole time; Xiao Yi let the contest for Jiankang go, preserved the strength of Jingzhou, waited for the enemy to be worn out by disease and by the siege, and then brought the whole structure down in one stroke through the coordination of water and land, the night attack that cut the retreat, and the pincer of the two armies. The massed thrust of the Spartan dory depended on the whole phalanx and on a citizen system of arms; the Liang had no such thing, but they found its equivalent in the water network of the Yangtze: the crossbow line pressed down on the wall from the bank, the river craft cut the road of escape in mid-channel, and the grain boats came on without a break from the upper river. That was the real weapon of this war.
